remarks: Welcome home to this classic colonial nestled at the end of a desirable and private cul-de-sac on a sprawling 1.5-acre property that can be enjoyed year-round.       Available immediately, this charming residence offers everything you need and more, featuring 4 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms spread over 2,786 square feet of comfortable living space and large windows overlooking the landscaped grounds. Step inside to discover the heart of the home, where a spacious kitchen and great room bathed in natural light offer the perfect setting for gatherings and relaxation. The well-proportioned living and dining rooms are ideal for entertaining while the additional flexible space of the sunroom/den/office off the living room creates an opportunity for a private retreat for work or leisure.        Whether you're enjoying the sunroom with a morning coffee or relaxing on the patio with friends, this delightful home invites you to MOVE RIGHT IN and experience the best of Darien and its surrounding areas. Don't miss the opportunity to make this your home sweet home!  IMMEDIATE OCCUPANCY AVAILABLE!
